In Oct. 2017, 12 million survivors and allies took to social media to discuss the impact of sexual violence—including many domestic and care workers. #MeToo is celebrating 5 years by going #BeyondTheHashtag and amplifying the work. Take action to join us: 
https://t.co/TRqVPJW9uT

#MeToo is more than a hashtag, it is a movement. On @metoomvmt’s 5th year anniversary, we celebrate our collective power and take action alongside a community of survivors, supporters, and practitioners, who are committed to actualizing the movement’s bold ambitions.

It’s been 5 years since #MeToo… 
👉🏿 Meaningful reforms have been implemented.
👉🏿 Yet, there’s still work to do.
